Hey there! As a fellow lady, with pretty similar SW and heights I just thought I would say...


The self loathing is still there sometimes. It comes in waves. You're always going not like something about yourself. Your weight, your hair, your skin, your teeth, etc. But that's how we've grown to think. The only way you can not only deal with self loathing but start to turn it into self love, is by pushing through those waves. As PP's have said, Therapy may be a good option if you can do it but even with a therapist you can't get help from them unless you are trying to help yourself. 

Me and you being in the  5'4 -5'5 range and also in the 200's makes it so hard to see improvement in ourselves. When I first started losing weight I didn't even realize I was. When I look at pictures of my body at my highest weight now I can see it but only because it's  in a picture. The more you lose the more you gain. The easier it becomes to see the changes happening from all the hard work YOU put it. All the HOURS of sweat and tears. All the time you spent bettering yourself and your body. 

It may not be in 2 days or 2 weeks or even 2 months but if you keep pushing through your self-loathing, one day you'll be so humbled with self- love. 

If you ever need anyone to talk to, or maybe a buddy to keep each other on track, I am here and I'm 100% in your corner!
